dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Thin, pale-grey margins on the folded flight feathers are visible with moderate boundary sharpness against the darker feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Distinct, roughly circular rufous-orange patch located on the posterior neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp color transition boundaries are visible between the grey crown, the rufous nape patch, and the grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail feathers are black with highly visible, large white elliptical spots arranged in three distinct transverse rows.
